newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds follow Chicago sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: European feeds follow Chicago sharply lower.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market followed last night's sharply lower Chicago soymeal futures close and offered South American soymeal pellets $2 to $9 lower, market sources said.
Chicago soymeal futures ended limit-down on new crop positions after USDA set U.S. soybean plantings at 70.9 million acres on Monday, the highest since 1982.
Most other products were offered around $2 lower in sympathy with soymeal.
But the lower prices met little buying interest during the early stages and not trades were reported.
"The market went down very fast and CBOT's Project A night trade was also lower, so most buyers stay sidelined to see whether Chicago futures continue lower this afternoon," one broker said.
"But if the Chicago opening would be called firmer we could see some action at these levels, provided there are then still sellers willing to part from their positions," he added.
